Gate 1 round 3 - CC-102 (the level-needs design: _NEEDS, plan_split report, first-turn stop, work bound, scorer)
Branch: fix/cc-102-original-question-parent-guard, commit under test: a46d288 (api/src, scripts and evals are exactly that commit)
Scope: api/tests/test_geography_completeness.py (rewritten this round), test_geography_report.py, test_comparison_work.py,
test_demo_harness.py and the changed tests in test_ask_loop.py (the whole file is run; it is a superset).

Mutation-check convention: revert ONE behaviour in api/src, scripts or evals, run the five in-scope test files (a superset
of the covering tests, so the per-test result doubles as the kill matrix), confirm the covering tests FAIL (GOOD) or not
(BAD, a surviving mutant), restore with 'git checkout -- <file>' (the src tree is committed, so that is a safe restore;
the runner then prints 'git status --short -- api/src scripts evals' to show it is clean). Test edits are never restored
by checkout. A mutation is named for the behaviour it reverts, not numbered. 'Covers tests' are named before the run; a
mutation with none named is a suspected survivor and the run settles it. Strict-xfail tests encode defects found in
src; each gets a temporary FIX DEMO showing it passes once the defect is fixed (pytest reports XPASS(strict) as a
failure), restored the same way. Runner and spec are scratch files outside the repo (the session scratchpad); results
are pytest's own output, --tb=no -rfX, unfiltered. Prefixes: C = test_geography_completeness, R = test_geography_report,
W = test_comparison_work, H = test_demo_harness, L = test_ask_loop.

Equivalent mutants and why no observable behaviour changes:
  - county: county_named is read as truthy rather than as exactly true (incomplete side)
      plan_split already turns county_named into a real bool (found.get(...) is True, killed on its own side by test_a_county_is_named_only_when_the_model_says_true_and_nothing_else), and incomplete reads only what plan_split returns, so a truthy non-bool can never reach it in production
  - tables: a non-text asks_for is not made text (the report side guard is redundant)
      plan_split already keeps asks_for only when it is a str (killed on its own side by test_plan_split_reports_asks_for_only_when_it_is_text), so incomplete never sees a non-text value and str(... or '') adds nothing
  - answer: the place and block group slots of the display order are dropped
      have can only ever hold state, county or tract (the three things incomplete adds), so no place or block group entry of _ORDER can ever match; dropping them changes no answer
  - fail open: a record with no split task is not recognised up front
      shield(None) raises TypeError, which the broad except Exception below turns into the same None; with no task nothing else differs
  - split call: parents come before names in the report (order only)
      the only reader of frame['named'] is incomplete, which uses it as a bag (whether any entry has a word, minus the skipped numbers); order cannot change a verdict
  - plan: the pinned flag is left as a bare value rather than a bool
      given is read only as `not given` in the next line, so None, [] and False are the same and a non-empty list is truthy exactly as True is
  - work bound: a single row is let into the pair loop
      with one usable row the pair loop has nothing to pair, so comparison_rows returns [] either way; only the cost of building two sets differs

Named covering tests corrected after pass 1 (the mutation was killed, but not by the test I named):
  - one county by number also demands a county: a county by number always carries its county, so only the
    metadata test can see it (behaviourally unreachable).
  - one tract by number also demands a tract: only reachable by a question whose written units do not include a
    tract; the new row 'Poverty by tract in county 5 of Ohio' reaches it.
  - the model's level is used as written: only a non-text level shows it, and the numbered-places test does.

Defect found in api/src (not fixed; strict xfail plus FIX DEMO, below):
  api/src/finish.py incomplete(): `single = bool(written)` makes any numbered unit a 'by number' question, whatever
  level the number belongs to. 'Median rent for every block group in county 5 of Ohio' (model reports level block
  group, named Ohio, numbered county 5) is refused for a missing tract, though the live API lists every block group
  from state and county alone (cc-102-geography-probes.md, request 28: 200, 33 rows). test_every_block_group_in_a_
  county_given_by_number_is_not_asked_for_a_tract. Suggested fix, shown in the FIX DEMO: ask for what each numbered
  unit takes by number (union of _NEEDS[(unit, True)] over the units the user wrote), not for the asked level's
  by-number row. Side effect to know: the answer's 'a block group identified by its number' wording would also need
  to follow the numbered unit.

Docs note: docs/requirements.md and docs/ask-path.md list the needs table without the (place, True) row that
finish._NEEDS carries (one place by number needs the state). The metadata test pins the row; the docs omit it.
